title: Arbor machine
description: One machine in the setup repo: machines/<machine>.json. The file name is the machine, compared loosely with the names Arbor shows (eden-dev-01.json is "Eden dev 01"). Move the file to machines/_archive/ to keep it on record without syncing.

name.description: How Arbor names the machine. The file name is what counts.

host.description: Its SSH host. Arbor offers to add it when it has no host by that name; it never connects to it unasked.

role.description: A label, like devbox. A project can list "@devbox" to be on every machine with this role.

codeRoot.description: Where projects go on this machine, as <codeRoot>/<owner>/<name>. Default ~/code.

skills.description: This machine's own value for a skill: off keeps it off this machine, own keeps the machine's copy.

plugins.description: This machine's own value for a plugin .agents/plugins.json lists, by name@marketplace.

mcp.description: This machine's own value for an MCP server.
